dedupe_keys.name: comparing built up area datasets to assess urban exposure to coastal hazards in europe

description: Comparing built-up area datasets to assess urban exposure to coastal hazards in Europe is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Hedda Bonatz et al. Information on urban land use, beyond the urban-rural dichotomy, can improve the assessment of potential impacts of coastal hazards by refining estimates of damages and supporting adaptation planning. However, the lack of a consistent definition of “urban” in previous studies has led to exposure estimates that vary considerably. Coverage: continental; published in 2024. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
